SUBJECT: HM102 FOOD PRODUCTION FOUNDATION -I

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The question paper contains 5 questions each of 5 marks and total 25 marks.

Q.1(a) What are the basic forms of organizational structure? [2]

Q.3(a) What is the importance of fuels? [2]

Q.5(a) Give four different types of Herbs and four types of spices used in Indian Food. [2]
Q.5(b) Explain in brief various types of Milk and Milk Products available in local market. [3]
